sentence: This project builds mathematical tools that guarantee neural networks controlling robots, aircraft and self-driving vehicles operate safely.
This project builds an automated weeder that removes weeds without chemicals or soil tillage, using machine vision to tell crops from weeds.
This project studies how land use intensification changes the way soil minerals break down, which supplies nutrients to plants.
This project builds a tool powered by a large language model that uses decoys to mislead attackers and protect scientific computing systems.
This project studies how a repair enzyme in bacteria fixes DNA damage caused by toxins that some bacteria make.
This project studies how alternating magnetic fields can make soft shape-changing materials change form while using very little energy.
This project builds machine learning methods that learn from imperfect geographic information contributed by volunteers.
This project builds tools that test how well the learning, sensing and communication parts of edge computing systems resist security threats.
This project studies why and when deep learning works and designs algorithms that make it more reliable.
This project builds algorithms that let optical clocks work as sensors for signals such as dark matter and gravitational waves.
This project builds lessons on protecting the privacy and security of health data, including data from smartwatches and mobile apps.
This project builds a computing cluster that spreads large research tasks across many local and global computing resources.
This project designs molecules that change shape and color when hit by visible light and that work in water and in solid materials.
This project builds a tool that predicts when machines will fail using sensor signals while keeping industrial data private.
This project uses genomic and isotopic data to work out the histories of human populations and how their movements changed over time.
This project uses measurements and a model to study how organic carbon moves into the mesopelagic zone through sinking particles, mixing and animals.
This project builds an artificial intelligence system of bounded autonomous agents that explain their decisions and keep people in control.
